title: Kellogg (Aust) Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Specialty Cereals Pty ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Kellogg Company and Kellogg (Aust.) Pty Ltd (jointly Kellogg) propose to acquire the business of Specialty Cereals Pty Ltd. Kellogg is a manufacturer, seller and marketer of ready-to-eat cereal and snack foods worldwide. Specialty Cereals is a privately owned ready-to-eat cereal and cereal and confection ingredient manufacturing business based in Sydney.
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was considered in the context of the following markets: 1. The national market for the retail supply of ready-to-eat breakfast cereals; and 2. The national market for the supply of cereal ingredients.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: 1. The low increase in market share as a result of the proposed acquisition; 2. Low barriers to entry evidenced by several recent new entrants; and 3. The existence of several competitors who will continue to provide alternative supply options for customers.
